recommendation: Disable cleartext FTP or enforce encrypted SFTP/FTPS
Disable Telnet immediately; migrate all remote access to SSH
Enforce HTTPS (TLS 1.3) and redirect cleartext HTTP traffic
Enforce public-key authentication, disable root login, and restrict access
Restrict RDP access behind VPN, enable NLA, and enforce multi-factor authentication
Disable SMBv1, enforce SMB signing, and isolate file shares from internet access
Disable NetBIOS over TCP/IP if not required; restrict outbound ports 137-139
Bind MySQL to localhost, enforce strict authentication, and restrict remote access
Require SSL connection for PostgreSQL and enforce client authentication rules
Enable auth in mongod.conf and do not expose database ports publicly
Set strong requirepass password, rename dangerous commands, and bind to localhost
Disable recursive DNS resolution for external clients and restrict zone transfers
Enforce STARTTLS, restrict open relays, and configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC records
